metadata.purpose: Executable single-storey office reference model using the SIA 380/2 comparison-project limit-case envelope and documented engineering assumptions where SIA 2024 or project data would normally be required.
metadata.claim_guardrail: This is a compliance-workflow reference model, not proof of official SIA 4010 software validation or project certification.
